detail.overview: Intex SRAC183I Inverter Split Air Conditioner Experience powerful and energy-efficient cooling with the Intex SRAC183I Inverter Split Air Conditioner, designed to deliver superior comfort even in extreme summer conditions. Equipped with an advanced inverter compressor, this AC automatically adjusts cooling capacity based on room temperature, ensuring consistent performance while reducing electricity consumption. The 100% copper condenser with anti-corrosion blue fin coating enhances durability and improves heat exchange efficiency for long-lasting performance. With Turbo Mode, the AC quickly cools your room, while the 4-way air swing ensures uniform airflow across every corner. Its sleek design with a hidden LED display complements modern interiors, and features like Sleep Mode, Eco Mode, Auto Restart, and Stabilizer-Free Operation make it a smart and reliable choice for your home. Perfect for medium-sized rooms, the Intex SRAC183I offers the ideal balance of performance, energy efficiency, and durability.
features: 1.5 Ton Inverter Split Air Conditioner – Ideal for medium-sized rooms (150–180 sq. ft.)
High-Efficiency Inverter Compressor for faster cooling & lower electricity consumption
100% Copper Condenser with Anti-Corrosion Blue Fin Coating
Turbo Cooling Mode for instant temperature drop during peak summers
4-Way Air Swing for uniform cooling across every corner
Sleep Mode for comfortable night cooling & power savings
Eco Mode for optimized performance and reduced energy bills
Hidden LED Display with Modern Premium Design
Stabilizer-Free Operation with Wide Voltage Range
